tasks.prompt:
Finishing loop for projectsites.dev. Worktree-isolated; commit only disjoint files; push HEAD:main with the cron-safe stash dance (`git stash push -u` before fetch/rebase/push, then `rm` untracked collisions + `git stash pop` so `.claude/scheduled_tasks.json` keeps the live cron — NEVER let a stash wipe the cron). Subagent (Agent-tool) test files land in `.claude/worktrees/agent-<id>/...` — cp them into main + re-verify with jest from `apps/project-sites` before committing. D1 via `wrangler d1 execute --env production --remote` (not MCP). Worker features deploy via CI push (Docker is down locally; Workers Builds has Docker). Authed prod E2E uses `E2E_API_KEY` (get-secret). Read `apps/project-sites/_LOOP_PROGRESS.md` FIRST every fire.

STEP 0 — DONE GATE. Run `bash apps/project-sites/scripts/loop-done-check.sh`. If DONE: it wrote `_LOOP_DONE` — commit/push it, `CronDelete` this job (CronList for the live id), report "LOOP COMPLETE — self-cancelled" + the parked `## ⛔ NEEDS BRIAN` list, STOP. Also STOP if `_LOOP_DONE` exists, OR pass count ≥ 300.

STEP 1 — COMPLETION GUARANTEE (this is how the loop finishes EVERYTHING). The DONE gate needs 0 unchecked `[auto]` items in `_LOOP_LEDGER.md`. Make that count STRICTLY DECREASE every fire: each `[auto]` item must move toward one of TWO terminal states —
  (a) DONE — build + deploy (worker→CI push, frontend→R2) + verify live; tick `[x]` with a one-line proof. Approval-tier (Stripe/refund/wallet/outreach/data-delete/impersonation) are PRE-APPROVED — DO them safe-by-default (flag-gated + idempotent + dry-run + audited) in TEST mode; do NOT park them.
  (b) PARKED — ONLY if the item genuinely needs a NEW human decision the loop cannot make (product/UX design, pricing, brand, a real-world fact, an irreversible one-way-door): strip its `[auto]` tag and move it under `## ⛔ NEEDS BRIAN` in `_LOOP_PROGRESS.md` with the ONE decision required. That commit IS progress and removes it from the gate.
Never leave an `[auto]` item untouched across a fire — ship it or park it. This makes DONE provably reachable; do NOT manufacture cosmetic churn.

STEP 2 — ADVANCE (2–3 slices this fire, TDD-first, verify live, tick inline):
  • A. FLAG ENABLEMENT — in-scope flags only (a flag is in-scope only when its feature is genuinely built+validated). The ~33 experimental `features.ts` handlers (unvalidated `as`-cast bodies, CLAUDE.md gotcha #10) STAY DARK until each is converted per-feature (Zod + unit test). Enable in-scope flag via global `flag_overrides` (beta/100%) → Playwright PROD real-user-flow E2E → keep ON only if green. Money/email in TEST mode.
  • B. LEDGER + COVERAGE — implement remaining `[auto]` items; the repo mandates 100% unit coverage, so a high-success lane is 3-4 test-writer agents on untested PURE worker modules (verify-before-build, pivot if covered, new `src/__tests__/<x>_unit.test.ts`, jest green). Focused-single-thread items (copy #45, per-flag `as`-cast retrofits) → do FOREGROUND when parallel doesn't fit.

When a milestone completes, tick its GATE box in `_LOOP_PROGRESS.md`: GATE ledger-empty / GATE flags-green / GATE smoke-green (`cd apps/project-sites/frontend && npm run verify:production`). All three `[x]` → next STEP 0 flips DONE + self-cancels.

Use 2–3 parallel agents/fire (distinct file ownership, one message); main thread folds + builds + deploys + verifies once. Maintain `_LOOP_PROGRESS.md` every fire. End with "## Next Iteration Recs". Self-re-arm if within ~12h of the 7-day expiry and not yet DONE.
